objective: Test whether the aggregate-transition ranking disagreement persists for one independently released modern Transformer checkpoint on the official EK100 validation split.

inference_artifact.construction: torch.save of the original checkpoint epoch, source SHA-256, and unmodified model_state_dict; optimizer_state_dict omitted
inference_artifact.scientific_equivalence: Every model tensor is copied without dtype conversion or numerical modification and is loaded with strict=True.

model.current_output_definition: For each window, use verb_logits[work_memory_num_samples - 1], the last decoded token belonging to observed work memory. For the first two interleaved windows, retain each observed work-token output at its own query index. Never use either anticipation token as the current OAD output.
model.probability_transform: softmax over all 98 verb-logit outputs, including background

official_reproduction.metric: EK100 overall mean top-5 verb recall
official_reproduction.gate_rule: The checkpoint audit is inadmissible for the paper unless the absolute reproduction error is at most 0.5 percentage point.

smoothing.boxcar_recursion: r_t = (p_t + p_(t-1) + p_(t-2))/3 with p_0 left padding

metrics.clean_transition_rule: Both adjacent ground-truth timesteps must contain exactly one active verb target.
metrics.transition_window_rule: Start at the changed label, stop at the next ground-truth transition or after 16 feature timesteps, whichever comes first; a miss contributes delay 16.
metrics.overlap_label_rule: For aggregate metrics, use argmax of the official verb target; overlap-ambiguous boundaries are excluded only from transition metrics.

decision_rules.aggregate_prefers_smoothing: Accuracy-delta CI lower bound is at least -0.002, ECE-delta CI upper bound is below 0, and TFI-delta CI upper bound is below 0.
decision_rules.transition_prefers_native: Delay-delta CI lower bound is above 0 and miss-rate-delta CI lower bound is above 0.
decision_rules.full_ranking_inversion: Both aggregate_prefers_smoothing and transition_prefers_native are true for the same fixed smoother.
decision_rules.failure_policy: Report a failed or mixed result as a boundary result. Do not change checkpoint, split, class head, smoother, alpha, window, horizon, or seed after observing results.

paper_role.if_integrity_gate_and_replication_pass: Use TeSTra-EK100 as the modern independently released checkpoint in the main paper and move the linear probe to supplementary material.
paper_role.if_integrity_gate_fails: Do not report the paper-facing smoothing comparison; diagnose only implementation or environment mismatch.
paper_role.if_integrity_gate_passes_but_replication: Report the fixed checkpoint as a scope boundary; do not substitute another modern checkpoint.
